CONTROLS.NAME: speed
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Forward flight speed down the tunnel.

CONTROLS.NAME: twist
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How hard the tunnel bends and turns. 0 = straight.

CONTROLS.NAME: vein_density
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Number of veins around the tunnel wall.

CONTROLS.NAME: vein_growth_speed
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How fast veins grow, shrink away and respawn.
How far veins turn into bubbles when the bubble wave passes. 0 = never.
CONTROLS.NAME: bubbles

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How often the veins-to-bubbles wave comes around (1 = about every 20 s).
CONTROLS.NAME: bubble_rate

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How far veins turn into spinning mannequin heads when the head wave passes. 0 = never. Select media to put a face on them.
CONTROLS.NAME: heads

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How often the head wave comes around (1 = about every 30 s).
CONTROLS.NAME: head_rate
sheen
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Strength of the oil-slick rainbow film over every surface.

CONTROLS.NAME: hue_drift
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Speed at which the whole palette rotates through hues. 0 = fixed colors.

CONTROLS.NAME: hue_shift
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Manual hue offset for the whole palette.

CONTROLS.NAME: audio_react
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How strongly the music drives the veins and bubbles: bass hits send pulses racing down the tunnel, highs make them sparkle. The walls and camera ignore the audio.

DESCRIPTION: Flying down a twisting organic tunnel that cycles through pitted clay, fuzzy coral, wet flesh and stones overgrown with vines and flowers under an oil-slick sheen, with veins that grow, writhe and respawn. Bass hits send pulses racing down the veins and bubbles; highs make them sparkle.
TITLE: Glimpse Before Death
